text.tspan: the wash rides on the car

svg.text: // the wash became methods on the object
a variable service welded into the data

text.tspan: the car drives through the wash

svg.text: it still keeps start() and lockDoors() — that's what a car is
intrinsic stays on the object — services stay outside
Data-Oriented Programming in Java — part of what it is, or a service it passes through?
